messages:
maria: Heads-up — GOV-Cloud partner wants an on‑prem + edge reference kit we can hand them next week. Need terraform templates that work with our private control plane and their air-gapped ops. Who can own module compatibility (arm64 + x86) and the smoke tests?

sanjay: I can take module compat. Did a quick pass on the refarch yesterday; split into 3 modules: network (vpc, firewall stubs), runtime (gpu/arm selectors + node pools), and deploy (manifest + init scripts).

maria: awesome, thanks. Do you have a repo branch or draft layout we can point partner at?

sanjay: Yup — pushed a prototype branch: https://git.redwood/example/edge-refkit/tree/partner-gov-proof. Key bits:
```hcl
module "runtime" {
  source = "git::https://git.redwood/example/edge-refkit.git//modules/runtime"
  arch = var.arch # "x86" | "arm64"
  node_count = var.node_count
}
```
Couple of notes: 1) we use feature flags to toggle private-control-plane creds, 2) KV cache disabled by default for air-gapped installs.

ellie: CI/devex note — we should have a minimal GH Actions matrix for arch (x86/arm64) + terraform fmt/validate + a tiny smoke apply using localstack or k3s in GH runners. That will catch provider drift.

sanjay: Agreed. I'll add a github workflow stub. Example matrix snippet:
```yaml
strategy:
  matrix:
    arch: [x86, arm64]
    tf_version: [1.3.9, 1.4.6]
```

maria: Partner asked for a checklist they can sign off on. Can we produce a 1‑page runbook: supported topologies, required network ports, certs/KMS flow, and rollback steps?

ellie: I'll draft the runbook. Suggest we include: supported OS images, kernel/driver notes for GPUs, KMS integration steps (sample commands), and a short troubleshooting section (logs to pull, key systemd units).

sanjay: For rollout policy — recommend starting with a single-node pilot, then canary 10% nodes, full. We'll add a terraform var for rollout_phase and an example snippet in docs.

maria: Perfect. Who will engage partner ops to run the pilot? I can coordinate timeline and get them VPN creds.

sanjay: If you can coordinate creds, I will run the first smoke apply and verify metrics.

ellie: I'll add the GH workflow and the smoke test harness (k3s + sample echo service), and wire an integration test that validates KV cache disabled state.

partner-onboard-bot: onboarding-checklist created • please update the repo README with the partner name and contact info.

maria: noted. I'll update README and post the partner contact details. Can we aim to have the draft runbook + CI stubs by EOD Thurs? :calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sanjay: EOD Thurs works for the repo PR.

ellie: I'll open the GH Actions PR and add reviewers (sanjay, maria). :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — will loop partner in after PRs land.
